items.title: The product of two algebraic spaces is an algebraic space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for algebraic spaces F, G over S, the product F x G is an algebraic space and is a product in the category of algebraic spaces over S (source lines 1111-1117). The proof verifies the defining conditions: the product of sheaves is a sheaf, its diagonal is the product of the diagonals of F and G and hence representable, and the product of surjective etale charts is a surjective etale chart by the product property for representable transformations.
